mapper.select:
SELECT id, category, title, content, tags, view_count, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_article
AND category = #{category}
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND is_active = 1
ORDER BY view_count DESC
SELECT id, category, title, content, tags, view_count, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_article WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1

SELECT cr.id, cr.user_id, cr.customer_id, cr.reminder_type, cr.title, cr.content, cr.priority, cr.status, cr.due_date, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at, cr.resolution_note, c.name as customer_name, c.phone as customer_phone FROM customer_reminder cr LEFT JOIN customer c ON cr.customer_id = c.id WHERE cr.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_reminder (user_id, customer_id, reminder_type, title, content, priority, status, due_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{customerId}, #{reminderType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{title}, #{content}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{dueDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_reminder SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NOTIFIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as notified, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as resolved, SUM(CASE WHEN priority >= 3 AND status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as highPriority FROM customer_reminder
AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_article (category, title, content, tags, is_active) VALUES (#{category, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{title}, #{content}, #{tags}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_article SET category = #{category, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, tags = #{tags}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, category, title, content, tags, view_count, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_article WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
